result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make **understanding other people a prerequisite for power**.

Not perfect empathy—just enough to recognize that every other person has a life, fears, and needs as real as one’s own. Leaders would have to consider those they affect, audiences would have to encounter perspectives unlike their own, and cruelty would become harder to excuse as “someone else’s problem.”

Much of the world’s suffering comes from treating people as obstacles, tools, or targets. I’d change that first.
